items.name: Cybernetic Eyes
items.description:
Description
A cybernetic eye can be enhanced by cyber art for no additional cost, giving it an unusual color or pattern. When a pair of eyes is installed, the user gains:

Darkvision 60'
+5 circumstance bonus on Perception checks
+4 resistance bonus on saving throws against blindness or visual effects.

items.name: Longsword, microserrated
items.description: The single edge of this sword looks homogeneous to the naked eye, but it is actually made of thousands of microscopic teeth. The teeth tear through organic matter, causing significant damage and bleeding.

items.name: Dermal Plating (Mark III)
items.description:
Description
These plates exist under the skin and provide increased resistance to physical attacks. They are undetectable normally, but are visible when struck and for a few moments afterwords.

items.name: Wirejack Tendons (Mark I)
items.description:
Description
Wirejack tendons not only strengthen and enhance existing reflexes, but also enhance the transmission of nerve impulses to surrounding musculature. Once installed, wirejack tendons grant an enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

items.name: Cyberfiber Muscles (Mark I)
items.description:
Description
Cyberfiber muscles are powerful synthetic muscles that augment but do not replace existing muscle mass in a creature. Once installed, cyberfiber muscles grant an enhancement bonus to Strength. This enhancement bonus alters price, implantation value, install DCs, and Craft DCs as listed below.

items.name: Thoracic Nanite Chamber (Mark I)
items.description:
Description
A thoracic nanite chamber augments the vital organs within a creature's chest, particularly its heart, lungs, and pulmonary system. Once installed, a thoracic nanite chamber grants an enhancement bonus to Constitution.

items.name: Cybernetic Ears
items.description:
Source Technology Guide pg. 37
Price 4,000 gp
Slot ears; Weight 1 lb.
Install DC 28; Implantation 1
DescriptionA cybernetic ear can be enhanced by cyberart at no additional cost, giving it an unusual color or shape. When a pair of ears is installed, the user gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Perception checks. This bonus stacks with circumstance bonuses on Perception checks from other cybernetic senses. Cybernetic ears grant a +4 resistance bonus on all saving throws against sonic effects.

items.name: Voice Amplifier
items.description: Greatly increases the volume of your voice. You can switch this device on or off as a swift action. While active, it grants +2 circumstance bonus on Intimidate and increases the DC of your "Shout" or "Word" spells by 1.

items.name: Implant Mesh (Mark I)
items.description:
Description

An implant mesh is a cybernetic augmentation that enhanced other cybernetic implants, notably those that heighten their wearers' physical abilities. If used to enhance cyberfiber musclesTG, a thoracic nanite chamberTG, or wirejack tendonsTG, an implant mesh must be installed on that piece of cyberware before the item is implanted in a body. 

 

This implant mesh supports up to 3 physical body mods with a maximum bonus of +2.

items.name: FNP90
items.description:
A PCC carbine with excellent performance already "out of the box". Designed with the participation of world bronze medalist in Semi-Auto Rifle Vadim Mikhailov. Accuracy, speed, comfort of recoil.

 

Colimeter scope provides +2 to hit. Silencer allows for sneak-attack within 1st range increment.
